# data.docker_buildx_history_records

<!-- Code generated by tools/genskill from the provider schema. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Kind: data-source. Back to [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md).

Lists the build records of a buildx builder, like `docker buildx history ls`: ref, name, status, start time and duration of each build, newest first. Records come from BuildKit's build history API on the builder's running nodes.

## Arguments and attributes

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `builder` | `string` | optional, computed |  |  | Builder whose records are read (`--builder`). Default `default`, the daemon's built-in BuildKit; other names are docker-container builders on the provider's daemon (see `docker_buildx_builder`). |
| `buildx_version` | `string` | computed |  |  | The buildx release whose output format and semantics this type mirrors (pin v0.38.2); not a runtime binary, the provider never runs buildx. |
| `content_sha256` | `string` | computed |  |  | SHA-256 of history_json, to detect drift without diffing the document. |
| `history_json` | `string` | computed |  |  | Build records of the builder as one JSON array (the `history ls --format json` view). |
| `limit` | `number` | optional |  |  | Maximum number of records, newest first. Default: all. |
| `records` | `list(object)` | computed |  |  | One entry per build record. |
| `refs` | `list(string)` | computed |  |  | Build record refs, newest first; each is a valid `ref` for `docker_buildx_history`. |

### `records`

nested attribute, list(object). One entry per build record.

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `created_at` | `string` | computed |  |  | Upstream `CreatedAt`. |
| `duration` | `string` | computed |  |  | Upstream `Duration`. |
| `id` | `string` | computed |  |  | Upstream `ID`. |
| `name` | `string` | computed |  |  | Upstream `Name`. |
| `status` | `string` | computed |  |  | Upstream `Status`. |

## Example

```terraform
data "docker_buildx_history_records" "recent" {
  builder = "default"
  limit   = 10
}

output "recent_builds" {
  value = [for r in data.docker_buildx_history_records.recent.records : "${r.name} ${r.status} ${r.duration}"]
}
```
